name: clawcodex-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Claw Codex, a Python reimplementation of the Claude Code command-line coding
agent. Its `src` package holds the agent loop, the model providers, the terminal interfaces and the tool system
the model calls (file reading and editing, search, shell commands, tasks, skills, scheduled prompts and more).

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is Claw Codex's tool system and its scheduled-task engine: every module under src/tool_system/ (the tool framework, registry, tool context, schema validation, tool search and rendering helpers, and the built-in tools under src/tool_system/tools/, including the Bash tool package src/tool_system/tools/bash/) and every module under src/scheduled_tasks/ (the cron expression parser and the session scheduler) except: the tool modules advisor.py, agent.py, lsp.py, mcp.py, mcp_resources.py, send_message.py, team.py, vision_analyze.py, web_fetch.py, web_search.py and workflow.py of src/tool_system/tools/; together with the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is the in-package docstrings
